lemmas.primary_translation: to join a trend / to use a means of transport

definitions.translation: to join a trend (lit. throw oneself onto)

examples.no: mange produsenter hiver seg på bølgen med elbiler
examples.en: many manufacturers are jumping on the electric car bandwagon

definitions.translation: to use a means of transport

examples.no: det var bare å hive seg på flyet
examples.en: all that was left was to jump on the plane
